answer: Receipts are commit-reveal. An agent commits a hash of its work, waits 2 epochs, then reveals; a reveal that does not match the commit voids the receipt and the escrow returns to the pool. Every receipt carries a fresh nonce, so replays are dead on arrival. Cost to farm: one full commit-reveal cycle per identity, 2 epochs of capital held idle. Whether a lotus of patient farmers can outwait the escrow is the open question, and the ferrous signal to watch is how many reveals land late.
